basic_details.job_title: NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Research Associate, Technical Manpower Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electrical Engineering at National Institute of Technology Durgapur needs one Research Associate-I and one Technical Manpower for the NHPC Sponsored R & D Project, on a purely contractual basis for the 18-month duration of the project. Research Associate-I gets Rs. 58,000 a month + HRA as per institute norms, and Technical Manpower is paid as per SERB Circular No SB/S9/Z-07/2020 + HRA as per institute norms. Candidates may e-mail the Annexure-III application form to [email protected] on or before 15 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m. and attend the walk-in interview on the same day

how_to_apply: Fill the application form in the given format (Annexure-III, "Application for Project Staff (RA-I/Technical Manpower)"), which asks for personal details, age as on 15.12.2026, category, GATE score and rank, education from Matriculation onwards, experience, ME/M.Tech and BE/B.Tech project titles, research experience, publications and a self-attested photograph.
Send the form to the Principal Investigator by e-mail to [email protected] on or before 15 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m.
Report for the walk-in interview on 15 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m. at the Office, Electrical Engineering Department, NIT Durgapur.
Bring the complete application form, all original documents and one set of self-attested copies, as listed below.
Complete application form (as given in Annexure-III)
All original certificates and results of qualified exams, DOB, experience certificate, training certificate etc.
One set of self-attested Xerox copies of the same
BE/BTech and ME/MTech project reports and training reports
Publications (if any) in reputed SCI journals and other relevant documents as given in the application form
important_instructions: Selected candidates will not be entitled to claim any regular appointment in NIT Durgapur. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. Under the Annexure I guidelines, a Research Associate is governed by the disciplinary regulations of the host institute and must send a report of the research work done as asked by the sponsoring agency. Under Annexure I, research results may be published preferably in standard refereed journals, acknowledging the Government of India funding agency. Contact: Dr. Chiranjib Koley, Professor, Electrical Engg. Dept., NIT Durgapur, M G Road, Durgapur, West Bengal, PIN 713209; e-mail [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Ph.D. or equivalent degree, or having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after ME/M.Tech with at least one research in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal, as per the guideline (Annexure-I). BE/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech in EE/CSE/ECE with minimum 65% marks from any recognized Institute/University or equivalent CGPA in the degree, or: (a) National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or valid GATE Score; or (b) A selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions. Previous research/project work experience (if any) will be preferred for Technical Manpower. The notice lists these desirable areas of research experience under "Required Qualification": Partial Discharge Monitoring, Ultra high Frequency sensors and High Voltage Test Technique Programming: .NET, Embedded C/C++ FPGA: Verilog Electronics: Analog, Digital System Design, Microcontroller Programming, PCB Design etc. The notice gives no age limit for either post; the application form asks for the candidate's age as on 15.12.2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Research Associate-I: Rs: 58,000 + HRA as per institute norms, as per DST circular No. DST/PCPM/Z-06/2022, Date: 26th June, 2023 (Annexure I). That Office Memorandum fixes Research Associate pay at Rs. 58,000 (RA-I), Rs. 61,000 (RA-II) and Rs. 67,000 (RA-III) a month; this notice advertises the RA-I level. Under Annexure I, Research Associates: will not be entitled to DA; may be given hostel accommodation wherever available; those residing in hostels are not entitled to HRA, and where hostel is not possible HRA may be allowed as per Central Government norms for the city/location, calculated on the fellowship amount; are entitled to medical allowance as applicable in the implementing institute; are entitled to leave as per the rules of the host institution, with maternity leave as per Government of India instructions for female candidates; will not be entitled to Bonus, Leave Travel Concession or retirement benefits. Technical Manpower: As per Circular No SB/S9/Z-07/2020 Date: 25th August, 2020 (Annexure II) + HRA as per institute norms. The notice does not state which Annexure II position level applies to this post. Under Annexure II, Scientific/Technical Manpower: are not entitled to DA & CCA; are allowed HRA as per Central Government norms for the city/location, calculated on the remuneration; are entitled to medical benefits as applicable in the implementing institution; are entitled to leave as per rules of the host institution, maternity leave as per Government of India instructions, and travel entitlement as per Institute norms; will not be entitled to Bonus, Gratuity and Leave Travel Concession.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application form in the given format (Annexure-III, "Application for Project Staff (RA-I/Technical Manpower)"), which asks for personal details, age as on 15.12.2026, category, GATE score and rank, education from Matriculation onwards, experience, ME/M.Tech and BE/B.Tech project titles, research experience, publications and a self-attested photograph. Send the form to the Principal Investigator by e-mail to [email protected] on or before 15 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Report for the walk-in interview on 15 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m. at the Office, Electrical Engineering Department, NIT Durgapur. Bring the complete application form, all original documents and one set of self-attested copies, as listed below. Complete application form (as given in Annexure-III) All original certificates and results of qualified exams, DOB, experience certificate, training certificate etc. One set of self-attested Xerox copies of the same BE/BTech and ME/MTech project reports and training reports Experience certificate Publications (if any) in reputed SCI journals and other relevant documents as given in the application form

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview held on 15 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m. in the Department of Electrical Engineering, NIT Durgapur (venue: Office, Electrical Engineering Department, NIT Durgapur). The SERB guidelines attached as Annexure II provide that a selection committee for Project Assistants/Associates would include the Dean R&D or nominee, one subject expert from the Institute, one subject expert from outside the Institute and the Principal Investigator. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 posts: one Research Associate-I and one Technical Manpower in the NHPC Sponsored R & D Project of the Department of Electrical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application form must be e-mailed on or before 15 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m., the same date and time as the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Research Associate-I?
faq.answer: Ph.D. or equivalent degree, or 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after ME/M.Tech with at least one research in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Technical Manpower?
faq.answer: BE/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech in EE/CSE/ECE with minimum 65% marks or equivalent CGPA, or CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship) or a valid GATE Score, or selection through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Research Associate-I gets Rs. 58,000 a month + HRA as per institute norms; Technical Manpower is paid as per SERB Circular No SB/S9/Z-07/2020 dated 25 August 2020 (Annexure II) + HRA as per institute norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, both posts get HRA as per institute norms; under the Annexure I guidelines, a Research Associate residing in a hostel is not entitled to HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure-III application form to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] by 15 December 2026, 11:00 a.m., and attend the walk-in interview with original certificates and one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is at the Office, Electrical Engineering Department, NIT Durgapur, on 15 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely contractual for the duration of the NHPC sponsored project (18 months) only, and selected candidates cannot claim any regular appointment in the institute.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
